title: Recording: All Things Must Pass demos by George Harrison | 1970
content:
Studio Three, EMI Studios, Abbey Road
Producers: George Harrison, Phil Spector
Engineers: Phil McDonald, John Leckie

27 May 1970 was the second recording session for George Harrison’s third solo album All Things Must Pass.

The majority of the album recordings took place at EMI Studios, Abbey Road, with some overdub and mixing sessions at Trident Studios towards the end of the project.

On the first two days Harrison recorded a total of 30 demos, the majority of which found their way onto the album. Fifteen songs were demoed on each day.

Harrison recorded just one take of each song on this second day. They were all solo recordings featuring Harrison on vocals and acoustic or electric guitar, except for ‘Wah-Wah’ which had a bass guitar part by Klaus Voormann.

The songs were:

  • ‘Run Of The Mill’
  • ‘Art Of Dying’
  • ‘Everybody/Nobody’
  • ‘Wah-Wah’
  • ‘Window Window’
  • ‘Beautiful Girl’
  • ‘Beware Of Darkness’
  • ‘Let It Down’
  • ‘Tell Me What Has Happened To You’
  • ‘Hear Me Lord’
  • ‘Nowhere To Go’
  • ‘Cosmic Empire’
  • ‘Mother Divine’
  • ‘I Don’t Want To Do It’
  • ‘If Not For You’

The full set of 30 demos was released in the super deluxe reissue of All Things Must Pass in August 2021.

Page last updated: 3 April 2025
